propositions: Jira workflows may forbid direct end-state transitions (e.g. open → done when only open → in_progress → done is allowed), causing outbound sync to fail and ticket to drift.

Cloud (AcliClient) raises RuntimeError and DC (JiraDataCenterTransport) raises ValueError or IllegalTransitionError when a direct transition is unavailable; both cases are caught separately today, preventing fallback.
Recorded STATUS events in append-only *-STATUS.json files capture the chronological sequence of actual hops rebar took, which can be replayed via intermediate allowed transitions.
Resume point must match against current Jira status name (via get_issue) in Jira-name space without inverting the non-injective LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA map, anchoring on the last positional match.

Replay calls transition_issue_by_name once per remaining hop in order; any hop raising RuntimeError, ValueError, IllegalTransitionError, or HTTPError aborts to comment-fallback + drift without partial retry.

The replay feature threads local_id as a new optional parameter to _update_one_scalar_update and self-resolves the tracker via config.tracker_dir(reconciler_repo_root()), keeping dispatch_one.py under module-size policy.
